column1: # snapshot: same-change identity refreshes over the frozen residual prose-pin manifest
#   "RequiredCopy" but which loads the residual-PROSE manifest named above. Go by
#   the manifest path, not the class name.
# contract: each row declares one RETAIN_BOUNDARY identity frozen in that manifest, and the
#   assertion name the tree now carries for it. The manifest row itself is never edited: its
#   identity set is pinned to the base revision's committed pin-corpus inventory, so an edit
#   there would break the historical partition permanently. A row is admitted only when the
#   old identity is gone from the tree and the new one is present, so a rename and its
#   re-freeze land in the same commit and a refresh cannot outlive the rename it records.
# lifetime: rows are permanent and are never pruned. The frozen manifest is anchored to an
#   immutable base revision, so a row stays true however often the live census
#   .devflow/logs/pin-corpus-inventory.tsv is regenerated by its own maintenance commits.
#   Deleting a row would re-break the rename it records.
